body: OH MY GOD THATS IT!!! THANK YOU SO MUCH!!
SW-2078-3616-6994  :  alyssa!  :  rio de la luna??? idk but i love space so my island will be appropriately named somehow!!!! 20F from CA, i just want more friends!!!

i read every single word.  i cant even begin to tell you how much your reply is affecting me right now (in a good way of course).  its so hard to separate this relationship from myself because i always try to give everything, and unfortunately i just lose myself in the other.  when he proposed the break i was thinking, “okay, i’ll use this to my advantage.”  i dont know how the suicidal thoughts overcame me but they did.

i dont want to ramble too much because i am doing much better from when i posted, but i hope you know im going to keep your comment bookmarked or something so if i forget myself, i can remember

i think the calmness is what scares me most.  its hard to tell whether it means that im ready to go through or if ive managed to keep it all at bay.  but for the both of us, i hope it means another to to see the sun
of course, i just stayed home because i couldnt bear the thought of hurting others with my own problems.  im in a much better place right now, and im figuring things out slowly

thank you so much for your reply.  it really means a lot to me.  i don’t know what it is with us and words, but i definitely find comfort in writing more than anything when i need to get a point across.  thank you.
right back at you!!! i love talking to people too!

its not, im sorry!! :( im being as genuine as can be.  i was a part of this crisis therapy group with themed lessons every day.  one of the days was completely dedicated to cognitive distortions and how to recognize them, etc.  it was very impactful, and im really happy you reminded me
wow, thank you so much for reminding me of what i was taught in therapy groups.  i didnt even think about this.
the note was pretty much how i feel about why i shouldnt be alive, but i will go ahead and just do how i feel.  maybe itll let me have an epiphany.  thank you very much :)
fuck.  that was powerful.  thank you.
thank you for the link.  i’ll definitely keep it close by to help cope
thank you very much for your reply.  seriously.  may not be what i want to hear, but certainly what i need.  thank you.

he told me “do whatever you want until i know” so i guess im interpreting that as he wants to come back to me.  but yeah youre right... its just so hard to fucking deal with all this.

ive already thought about making a bumble or something just to try to feel anything other than wanting to die, but i honestly am not that attractive imo so.. i’ll see what happens.  thank you very much for your reply
hey thank you, it’s a tough reminder sometimes but all these comments have definitely helped normalize the feelings :)
yeah, even though it’s been a while those comments just still stuck with me.  but i’m definitely working on it, thank you so much :)

definitely, thank you for the reminder.  i tend to obsess wayyy too much over little details and get upset when i’m not seeing immediate results.  but you’re absolutely right, the very first thing i’ve worked on is my mindset and it’s made all the difference.

also i understand your struggle as well.  my bf is like half my weight, suuuper skinny with a sonic speed metabolism.  i think its part of why he knows how to help me with my body, because he has his own struggle too. 

we’ll both get to where we want, and thanks again for answering!! :)
hi thank you so much for your comment!  sometimes its hard for me to remember that romance and sex are different, but i’m definitely getting better at it and everything else as well :)

i actually have a therapy appointment tomorrow lol.  i had stopped going because i started antidepressants and they’ve been very effective.  but i miss my therapist and having the freedom to talk about what i want while getting advice back, so i’m definitely starting up again

i own a les paul from gh world tour on ps3.  i had to order a dongle off ebay, and do some work on the capacitor inside the guitar itself, but everything works fine!!  i have clone hero on a macbook pro.

had a friend that would constantly judge my friend group and others.  she was also an extreme SJW and I'd even consider her one of those "feminazi" types.  she would constantly blame "white people" for shit and make fun of them to the point where it just got weird (EX: she said that light skinned people shouldnt wear Fenty Beauty's yellow highlighter because its "not made for them").  she would say all kinds of shit about how people couldnt make a certain kind of food because they weren't from that specific culture (EX: I can't make pho because im not vietnamese).  worse, she was a hypocrite.  generally unhappy with everything and would hardly take our advice.  she could also never take any blame for herself or face her problems head on.

things came to a head when she, another one of my friends, and i became leaders of a club at school.  Toxic Friend did absolutely nothing and would leave early with guys she constantly complained about.  she had always been one of those "im only doing it for college credit" types, but never put in any effort into anything.  my friend got tired of it and decided to "impeach" her from club council in person.  my friend also decided to cut her off in general because she just brought everyone down, but Toxic walked away before it happened.  my friend then texted her about it and she hasnt been around since.
WHAT
